Dear Theo,

Re: balcony door lock, Flat 20, 110 Meadow Row, Northbridge, ZZ2 5ZZ (ref R/PM023-2)

The locksmith from Juniper Surveying has tried to reach you by phone and left a voicemail to arrange a time to attend. Their note shows the message was left for Freya Langley, so please could you check your voicemail (or with Freya, if she lives with you) and call them back to agree an appointment. If the number they called (07700 900353) isn't the best one for you, just reply with the right number and we'll pass it on.

In the meantime, please keep the balcony door closed and avoid leaving the flat with it as the only unsecured entry if you can.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings
